about: sha256 (64 lowercase hex characters) of each reviewed release build: build/release/contract.wasm (ink), shop/build/release/contract.wasm (shop), stories/build/release/contract.wasm (stories), sponsor/build/release/contract.wasm (sponsor), multisig/build/release/contract.wasm (multisig), editions/build/release/contract.wasm (editions). Fill each in from the published, reproduced release hashes (AUDIT_SCOPE.md), never from a hash this tool or a build printed. "" means not pinned yet: mainnet upload, wire and wire-stories refuse until it is filled in. Changing a value needs review like any contract change.
